{{Quote|Is there an old junker taking up space in your hangar bay? Donate it to the Resource Reclamation Initiative today!|Republic Announcer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Resource Reclamation Initiative''' was an initiative by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during and after the [[war against Zakuul]]. On [[Carrick Station]], announcements were periodically broadcast to incentivize individuals on the [[Space station/Legends|station]] to donate their junk to the initiative.<ref name="TOR" />
